about_the_game:
Encave is a first-person survival builder set in a post-disaster world. Trapped in an underground bunker, you must explore, gather hidden resources, and trade with other survivors to expand your base. Build a thriving underground community while defending against growing threats. Create a safe haven and ensure your survival in this dangerous new world.

Game Features:

Manage your resources

Defend yourself and your allies against scavengers and mutated creatures to stay alive.

,

Farm – Grow plants and vegetables for sustainable resources.

Scavenge and recycle for valuable resources

  • Upcoming Features (In Development)

Craft & Build Equipment – We’re refining the crafting system to let you gather resources and create essential tools, weapons, and survival gear.

Interact with Other Survivors – Work is underway to deepen interactions, allowing you to recruit allies, build relationships, and uncover hidden stories.

Expand Your Bunker – We’re adding new construction options so you can build and upgrade rooms to improve your shelter’s functionality.

Assign Jobs & Manage Residents – A detailed job system is being fine-tuned, enabling you to assign roles and optimize your community’s survival.

Trade & Unlock Blueprints – We're improving the trading system, letting you exchange goods for blueprints to unlock advanced tools, weapons, machines, plants, and furniture.

Maintain & Repair – We’re enhancing repair mechanics to keep your equipment and utilities functional, ensuring your bunker remains habitable.

These features are actively being developed, and we can’t wait to share more updates soon!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: 4 hardware CPU threads - Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 1 GB or more
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Encave is a first-person survival builder where you are trapped in an underground bunker after a disaster strikes the world above. Your main goal is to survive and expand your bunker by mining, inviting other survivors, building production equipment, and trading with other surviving groups.
